description: Use when the person has decided to buy a Polystate service — e.g. 'book the Wyoming LLC', 'start my Paraguay residency'. With a Polystate API key it starts a checkout and returns the link; without a key it returns the polystate.io page where the person books instead, and no checkout is created. No payment is taken until the person completes it. Give the service `id` (most reliable) or the `service` name from list_services (case, accents and hyphens are ignored), optionally narrowed by `country`. A partial or ambiguous name returns candidates instead of booking. Returns checkoutUrl/sessionId/totalAmount/currency for card-checkout services, or ctaUrl/note for services handled by a partner. Confirm with the person before calling.

category.description: Internal numeric service category id. Rarely needed.

country.description: Narrow the match to one country: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'PY' or 'Paraguay'.

service.description: Exact service name or id as returned by list_services, e.g. 'Wyoming LLC Formation'. A partial name returns candidates instead of booking.

name: book_service
title: Book a Polystate service
